thread:
Alex: Heads-up — rolling deploy for model-service and the user-profile-merge toggle tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. plan is to pin model-service to v2.1 during the DB migration window to avoid schema mismatch. release notes snippet below.

Priya: are we doing a gradual enable for the flag or a big switch? worried about cascades into search.

Mateo: gradual. propose 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m soak at each step and health gates. easy to abort in between.

Jordan: agree on gates. define rollback triggers now: error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency +25% vs baseline for 10m. add an ops override to pause ramp immediately.

Samira: also add tracing on merge path and an eval prompt set to run on canary traffic. if quality drops >3 points we rollback.

Alex: added to notes. release notes: "Model-service pinned to v2.1 during profiles_v2 migration; user-profile-merge flag to be ramped gradually. Rollback criteria: 1.5% error rate / p95 +25% / quality regression >3 pts."

Mateo: command to pin is: ```/deploy pin service:model-service version:v2.1 --until=2026-03-23T04:00Z --reason="profiles_v2 migration"```

deploy-bot: queued: pin request recorded, job 4521. target env: prod-eu, prod-us. ETA: immediate. :white_check_mark:

Priya: schedule for ramp: start 02:10 UTC with 0.1% for 15m, check telemetry, then move. I'll own the go/no-go at each step.

Jordan: I'll script the automatic abort check. snippet: ```if errors_5m > 1.5% or p95 > baseline*1.25: notify #eng-oncall and halt_ramp()```

Samira: ops-bot can we get a canary dashboard link and heatmap for the merge path?

ops-bot: canary dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary/4521 heatmap upload will stream during ramp.

Alex: quick note — don't unpin until DB migration finished and followup smoke tests pass. Unpin plan: after migration complete, keep pin for 2 hours of stable traffic, then `/deploy unpin service:model-service version:v2.1` and start final 25%->100% jump with same gates.

Priya: one more: add header to canary requests `X-Canary-Job: 4521` so we can slice logs easily.

Mateo: putting a sticky cohort for internal QA (10K users) to soak at 5% for the whole window.

Jordan: deploy-bot status: job 4521 -> pinned on prod-us & prod-eu; canary traffic slice created: id 4521-C. monitoring hooks enabled. :rocket:

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: 02:05 UTC precheck (db locks, migrations dry-run), 02:10 start ramp.

Samira: copying release note for docs: "During migration, model-service pinned to v2.1; user-profile-merge toggled via gradual rollout. Contact @Priya for ramp approvals; @Jordan for aborts."

Alex: any objections? otherwise we run tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup: all good from my side.

Mateo: no objections. will monitor QA cohort.

Jordan: I'll be on-call during the window.

Samira: on standby for trace review.

Alex: great — thanks everyone. I’ll post final release notes and the post-mortem template after the run.
